The Wedding Anniversary Dance  :
Your wedding DJ will invite the married couple to the dance floor, the most popular song played is often there 1st dance back in the day.
The DJ will invite the Guests /Family to share a Anniversary dance with the newlyweds, usually with slow wedding music.


Facts:

Remember when DJs first started on the radio, then at private party’s using records, or playing music from the jukebox, 8 tracks, then cassettes, Now most DJs play music from laptop. I hear many people saying how they used to love listening to there music in this way.It brings back memory’s that will last forever..

Anniversary DJ – Questions & Answers
Why hire an Anniversary DJ?

We specialize in Bay Area Anniversary DJ services for milestone celebrations like 20th, 50th, 75th wedding anniversaries, and even work anniversaries. A professional DJ like Chris ensures your music is customized to your taste, your guests, and the event mood.

Call DJ Chris ☎ 1-415-350-5474 to book your celebration.

What type of music do you play for anniversaries?

We create playlists to capture your memories — from romantic slow songs to fun party hits. The highlight is often the Anniversary Dance, where the couple relives their first dance and invites family and guests to join.

Happy Anniversaries to Steve & Marie – 50th Wedding Anniversary, San Jose Fairmont, Jan 2026: “Thanks for the great music. Everybody loved the oldies and the sound level was perfect!”

Do you provide additional services for anniversary events?
Yes! We offer video screen projection for your memories, photo slideshows, and music from all eras. We also provide weekday & Sunday discounted rates for weddings and anniversaries.
What is a DJ?
A DJ (Disc Jockey) is an individual who selects and plays music for an audience. DJs started on the radio, then at private parties using records, jukeboxes, and cassettes. Today, DJs perform with laptops, bringing both nostalgia and modern sound to your celebration.
How to book your Anniversary DJ?
Contact us to submit your booking for Bay Area Anniversary DJ services. We have DJs available across Northern California and offer free consultation. Call DJ Chris ☎ 1-415-350-5474 to secure your date!
